scope: Independent exact replacement encoded visual/narration review. Editorial POST keeps continuous soundwatch, host/Apple and publication gates separate.

lessons.reason: The exact repaired movie earns POST through concrete path resolution, grant intersection, persistent-file versus process lifetime and narrow broker return mechanisms. All18 prior scene-sheet views and nine registered native views are SHA-identical and independently rebound. Seven changed extra MP4 natives were personally viewed, with four unchanged prior extra-native views also rebound. The sole material finding is resolved at measured30fps boundaries. Platform/dependency/verification schematics retain honest craft deductions.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Ordinary process reach is narrowed to source/tests while Git metadata and home credential branches are denied.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The opening uses a clear authority map, with simple branch changes rather than a worked operation.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: ABI probe, ruleset, grants, no-new-privileges and enforcement remain separate steps; unavailable required coverage blocks launch.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The staircase is readable and scoped, though much of the explanation is a settled checklist. Launch after enforcement is a condition, not an executed receipt.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Distinct rights lead to the descriptor/enforcement distinction, sibling/future-child scopes and an inherited open descriptor that survives a later path restriction.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Persistent process and descriptor identities make the scope concrete. Closing the inherited handle updates the active state; no real kernel execution is claimed.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A parent WRITE grant reaches source/output/config/hooks; a child READ grant does not subtract it, while a restrictive layer removes metadata reach.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Actual per-resource decisions change with the grant composition and keep source/output admitted.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same directory tree enacts source traversal, two parent entries, a symlink jump and a separate hook branch before the final allow/deny decision.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Late contact-sheet samples can miss the short final verdicts. Exact natives264.1/280.3/297.2 confirm all three expected verdicts; there is no missing-verdict finding.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The exact helper resolves and decides five cases, then three wider names are admitted while exact .git/config remains denied.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The helper policy and stricter source-only model are explicitly distinguished, as is the check-to-use gap.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Worker lifetime, persistent hook, later host checkout and its child occupy separate time lanes; protected replay removes planting and the later child.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The same file survives worker exit and crosses into a distinct host execution. Toy time and policy scope are explicit.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Two configuration values retain their particular Git triggers; an editor task persists across worker exit until a trusted host consumes it.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The trigger conditions are visible and accurate. The Git half is schematic, with less construction than the main hook timeline.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Denied tracing/raw-socket primitives differ from an admitted open that still traverses filesystem policy; effective rights are their intersection.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The separate mediation stages are legible but remain a compact settled schematic.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Host source, metadata, runtime and scratch map to actual worker paths with RW/RO tags; the absent seccomp FD stays separate.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The mount mapping is concrete. The second half is mainly a static control distinction and does not claim mount isolation proved syscall filtering.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Configured Mac operation decisions are separate from an authored failed-profile fixture that blocks launch and starts zero workers.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The configured policy and test-only startup outcome are clear; actual macOS enforcement remains unexecuted.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A whole-project grant visibly includes config/hooks despite direct SSH denial, then four parameter slots precede custom-profile initialization.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The delayed host consequence and parameter inventory explain the gap, but several settled boxes hold for long intervals.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Worker without a credential reaches a broker; admitted GET differs from other-repository GET and POST, which stop before API reach.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The trust boundary is clear, though the three-node mechanism is less rich than the path and lifetime constructions.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Exact method/repository/pull-number admission precedes a response projection retaining number/state and dropping a named test-only debug field.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Field identities persist across the return boundary. Fixed-origin and local-fixture captions prevent a false network or credential proof.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Approved package bytes match a trusted digest and enter a read-only mount while runtime restrictions persist; unsupported required coverage blocks launch.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The identity-versus-behavior distinction is useful, with long largely settled diagram holds.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Expected policy results and UNEXECUTED host-enforcement cells occupy separate columns for five real-operation probes.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The matrix clearly refuses to substitute computed policy for host evidence; its visual construction is limited.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A new build-cache symlink resolves to metadata, then a different broad grant leaves a task file for later approved host execution.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The prior premature DENY/HOST finding is resolved: neutral prediction survives through the full result clause and the completed answer appears in the next30fps frame. The final unexecuted-probe recap remains an accurate settled schematic.
